unit: Deposited MAS5.0 signal, per native GEO family SOFT #VALUE field. Not RNA counts/FPKM and not protein.
data_scope: All8 deposited arrays and all3 GPL1261 exact-symbol Bub1b probes; no cherry-picked probes or arrays.

rows.detection_scope: Native within-sample detection call/P only; not a between-condition differential-expression test.
Native within-sample detection call/P only; not a between-condition differential-expression test.
rows.detection_limit: All eight calls are absent; these low signals are background-limited and do not independently establish transcript presence or abundance change.

rows.detection_scope: Native within-sample detection call/P only; not a between-condition differential-expression test.

method: Descriptive means and sample SD (n-1); ratio of group arithmetic means. Native matrix values cross-checked exactly against each sample SOFT table. No CEL reprocessing, inferential test, multiplicity correction or recreation of authors differential-expression pipeline.
biological_unit_limit: Four array samples/group. Sample descriptions say n=6 optic nerves; paper says12 nerves/6mice per transcriptomic group and experiments in triplicate. Exact pooling/independence map unresolved.
composition_limit: Bulk optic nerve; astrocyte association is based on intersection with published astroglial lists, not sorted-cell or per-cell BUB1B measurement.

candidate_provenance.scope: All 24 targeted values, all three exact-symbol probes, all eight sample labels and descriptive statistics copied unchanged. No full transcriptomic or raw CEL reanalysis.
candidate_provenance.normalization_limit: Paper describes MAS-5 then baseline transformation to the all-sample mean; deposit defines VALUE as MAS5.0 signal and names GeneSpringGX12. No normalization/filter pipeline is reproduced.

detection_call_check.scope: All24 targeted cells and native definitions read; no whole-SOFT or raw-array reanalysis.

portable_replay.inputs: Three official hash-pinned gz files supplied by caller; no download or raw CEL processing.
portable_replay.claim: 24 exact matrix/SOFT matches, sample/annotation/detection fields and descriptive summaries only; no differential-expression inference.

native_detection_fields.!Sample_data_processing: Data processing was performed using Agilent Genespring GX 12
native_detection_fields.#ABS_CALL: indicating whether the transcript was present (P), absent (A), or marginal (M)

detection_interpretation: One probe is absent in every array; another has one absent lithium call; the third is present in every array. Retain all features without treating three probes as three independent studies or detection P as DE P/FDR. Lower processed probe signals are not a validated RNA-abundance decrease.
